blocks.text: Garie Concepcion beamed with gratitude as she revealed that she and singer Michael Pangilinan are set to welcome their second child in 2027. Garie, daughter of actor Gabby Concepcion and businesswoman Grace Ibuna, revealed her pregnancy through her Instagram page on Saturday, Oct. 31. “Another beautiful reminder that God’s plans are always greater than ours. Our family is growing and our hearts are too,” she wrote, showing the sonogram of her baby. “Our 2026 plot twist, blessing and miracle. 2027, we’re excited for you!” she added.
